# Sentinel

Serverless uptime monitoring and incident alerting, built on AWS.

## What it does

Monitors URLs at regular intervals using AWS EventBridge and Lambda. Sends email alerts via SES when a service goes down and resolves incidents when it comes back up. All infrastructure is provisioned with Terraform.

## Stack

- Frontend: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Auth: AWS Cognito
- Backend: AWS Lambda (Node.js), API Gateway
- Database: DynamoDB
- Scheduler: AWS EventBridge
- Alerts: AWS SES
- Infrastructure: Terraform

## Live

https://sentinel-kappa-wine.vercel.app
